symbols.name: half-length output index
symbols.meaning: The output index of a half-length transform, with $0 \le \sigma < q/2$, so that the full output index is $\ell = 2\sigma + b$.
symbols.quote: Let $\sigma$ be the output index of a half-length transform, with $0 \le \sigma < q/2$.

symbols.name: bit-reversal map
symbols.meaning: The map sending an index $\ell$ with $0 \le \ell < q$ to the integer whose $\lg q$ binary digits are those of $\ell$ in reverse order.
symbols.quote: Let $\mathrm{rev}(\ell)$ be the integer whose $\lg q$ binary digits are those of $\ell$ in reverse order.

relations.quote: Radix-two factorization splits the [Discrete Fourier transform](discrete-fourier-transform.md) of length $q$ into $\lg q$ layers, when $q$ is a power of two.
Its layers are built from [Butterfly](butterfly.md) maps on pairs of entries, so the whole transform costs on the order of $q\lg q$ operations instead of the $q^2$ of the defining matrix product.
